title: GoldenItem
description: A single entry in the golden eval corpus (SP-G1, PRD L279). Each item pins an expected outcome for a goal that the autonomous-SDLC agent should be able to decompose and execute.

goal.description: The natural-language goal submitted to the agent.

expected_dag.description: The expected TaskGraph as a list of TaskNode objects (PRD L176). The graph must be acyclic and all depends_on ids must resolve within this list.

expected_criteria.description: The flat list of acceptance criteria the agent's output must satisfy.

expected_trajectory.description: Coarse phase-list of expected execution steps. May be a placeholder list of phase descriptions when a full step-by-step trace is not yet available.

version.description: Corpus version at which this item was authored (e.g. 'v0.1.0').

notes.description: Provenance, signoff status, and grounding notes. Items not yet operator-signed must contain 'needs-operator-signoff'.

TaskNode.title: TaskNode
TaskNode.description: A single node in the decomposed TaskGraph (PRD L176). Faithful to the contract: {id, phase, summary, depends_on:[id], acceptance_ref, allowed_paths:[glob]}.

id.description: Unique identifier for this node within the DAG.

phase.description: The SDLC phase this node belongs to.

summary.description: Human-readable description of what this node does.

depends_on.description: List of node ids this node depends on (empty for root nodes).

acceptance_ref.description: Reference to the TaskSpec acceptance criterion this node satisfies (e.g. 'SP-00e.5 / detects-dead-symbol').

allowed_paths.description: Non-empty list of non-catch-all glob patterns restricting which file paths this node may modify. A catch-all glob (**,*,.,/) is FORBIDDEN (SP-02/2.6 — else SP-06 scope-root is unreachable).

items.description: A concrete file glob derived from this node's acceptance_ref.

TrajectoryStep.title: TrajectoryStep
TrajectoryStep.description: One step in the expected execution trajectory (coarse phase-level placeholder).

phase.description: The SDLC phase this step belongs to.

description.description: What the agent is expected to do in this step.
